title: Beyond the 956: Chuck Norris, ‘Walker, Texas Ranger’ star, dies at 86
excerpt: Chuck Norris, the martial arts champion turned action-movie star and the face of CBS’s ‘Walker, Texas Ranger,’ died March 19, 2026, at 86 in Hawaii after a sudden medical emergency.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Chuck Norris, the martial arts champion turned action-movie star and the face of CBS’s Walker, Texas Ranger, has died at 86.

Norris died on March 19, 2026, in Hawaii after a sudden medical emergency, his family announced the next day in a statement posted on his Instagram account. “While we would like to keep the circumstances private, please know that he was surrounded by his family and was at peace,” the family said. No cause of death was publicly released.

Born Carlos Ray Norris on March 10, 1940, in Ryan, Oklahoma, Norris became a six-time undefeated World Professional Middleweight Karate Champion before Hollywood came calling. He broke into films opposite Bruce Lee in The Way of the Dragon (1972), starred in a run of 1980s action hits including Missing in Action, and played Texas Ranger Cordell Walker on CBS’s Walker, Texas Ranger from 1993 to 2001. The satirical “Chuck Norris Facts” later turned the tough-guy image into an internet phenomenon he embraced with good humor.

Off screen, Norris founded Kickstart Kids in 1990, a program that teaches martial arts and character to schoolchildren. His widow, Gena Norris, gave her first interview since his death this week, telling Men’s Journal she plans to carry forward the businesses and charitable work they built together.

Rest in Peace, Chuck Norris.

Sources: Reuters (March 20, 2026); Variety; family statement on Instagram; Men’s Journal.
